verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs say agents analyze requirements and implement features or fix bugs from plain-language prompts, including via SDK `agent.run(prompt=...)`. Agents present a structured plan showing each implementation step, and Codegen can create tasks in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com 'based on development needs and project requirements.' Together these deliver the core of intent-to-scoped-task. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how a request is scoped or broken into a task spec (acceptance criteria, boundaries), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
